annotations.title: Premium benchmark vs the US market

description: Benchmark your asking price (or premium %) for one tracked product against today's listed US dealer asks: your premium over spot, the market 25th percentile, median and 75th percentile premium, your percentile rank, and the Bullion Premium Index row (CC BY 4.0) with its dealer count. Aggregates only: no dealer is named.

payment.description: Which market price list to compare with.

product.description: Tracked product slug from list_products (for example american-silver-eagle-1oz) or a name with its weight. A name only matches a product of the same weight.

spot.description: Optional spot price in USD per troy oz to use instead of Bullion Price Check's latest reading (gold-api.com). The answer labels it spot_source=caller.

spot_asof.description: Optional ISO time of the spot you passed in, echoed back as spot_asof.

your_premium_pct.description: Your premium over spot in percent (use instead of your_price).

your_price.description: Your single-unit asking price in USD.

name: benchmark_premium
